facts.note: The trial abstract states a parallel-group placebo-controlled design but not randomization; the RCT indexing label and pooled review do not supply a sentence from the trial itself establishing randomization.

quotes.text: A double-blinded, placebo-controlled, parallel group study was performed in a high-risk group of hospitalized patients receiving a new prescription for a beta-lactam antibiotic and having no acute diarrhea on enrollment.

Lyophilized Saccharomyces boulardii or placebo (1 g/day) was given within 72 h of the start of the antibiotic(s) and continued until 3 days after the antibiotic was discontinued, after which the patients were followed for 7 wk.

facts.note: The trial abstract names Saccharomyces boulardii and placebo but does not state random assignment between them; randomized-trial descriptions in the accompanying review are not this trial's own report.
